methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 high-search food dehydrator models spanning stackable (vertical-airflow round) and box/shelf (horizontal-airflow) designs including current bestsellers and notable premium options. Specs independently re-verified against manufacturer product pages (cosori.com, nesco.com, excaliburdehydrator.com, tribest.com, brodandtaylor.com, magicmillusa.com, gopresto.com, ivationproducts.com, hamiltonbeach.com), official online store listings, instruction manuals, and corroborated via major retailers (Amazon, Walmart, Lowe's, Best Buy, Home Depot) and specialty retailers. Wattage and temperature ranges are from official specs or instruction manuals; tray-area figures use manufacturer-published sq ft where available, otherwise calculated from published tray dimensions. Booleans (adjustable_thermostat, expandable_trays) are true when explicitly confirmed; airflow values are "horizontal" for rear/side-mounted fans (box dehydrators) and "vertical" for top/bottom-mounted fans (stackable round units, per NESCO/Presto convention where a top/bottom fan drives air vertically through the stack). priceUsd reflects current published US retail price (official manufacturer store where available) verified as of accessedAt 2026-06-20. Two figures were corrected against the draft: Magic Mill MFD-9100 tray area (draft's self-styled 9.03 sq ft 'conservative calc' replaced by manufacturer-published ~10.8 sq ft) and its temp range (95-158 corrected to 95-165 per magicmillusa.com); Excalibur 3926TB regular/compare-at price corrected to 299.99.
